'''April 2001 Quebec tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 28 April 2001. [[Dominic Gaudreault]] won it. It is known from Dominic Gaudreault's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2229">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-03-quebec-by-ta-mere-no-html-tagd2229/ quebec-by-ta-mere-no-html-tag], DeckTech (Dominic "Decktech" Gaudreault, 3 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-03-quebec-by-ta-mere-no-html-tagd2229/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 April 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Dominic Gaudreault]]
